answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Every claim climbs the echo of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the whisper re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. Reaching the copper of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, diluted when peers disagree, no identity may audit its own recruit.
